BikeWalkBG Weekly Community Women's Bike Ride

Bowling Green, KY · Downtown · Social

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendly

BikeWalkBG Weekly Community Women's Bike Ride is a social group ride in Bowling Green, KY. It rolls every Monday at 5:30 pm from Warren County Bike Safety Park at the Fringe. Pace: easy.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BikeWalkBG Weekly Community Women's Bike Ride group ride

A free women's community ride organized by the county's BikeWalkBG program from the downtown bike safety park. Family rides and a monthly seniors ride run from the same spot.
